settings.info.actionDecorations: The small marks that show what a player did this turn.

settings.info.autoDirector: The camera follows the action on its own.
settings.info.backdrop: What is shown behind the stadium.
settings.info.backdropColor: The backdrop color when Backdrop is set to a color.

settings.info.blockDieSurface: The surface the block dice land on.

settings.info.botUrl: Where tournament data comes from. Leave it blank for https://<server host>, or http://<local host>:4310 on a local server.
settings.info.brightness: Brightens or darkens the pitch only.
settings.info.castShadows: Players cast soft shadows on the pitch.
settings.info.chatStyle: Chat as bubbles in the speaker's team color, or as plain lines.
settings.info.chatToastPos: Where chat toasts appear on the screen.
settings.info.chatToastTextSize: Text size of the coach name and message in chat toasts. Minimum text size can raise it.
settings.info.chatToasts: New chat messages pop up over the pitch.
settings.info.checkerFont: The font on the checker pieces.
settings.info.clickDismiss: Big splash screens stay up until you click.
settings.info.coachBadges: The rank badge style next to coach names.
settings.info.coachBrain: A test bot that plays for you during development.
settings.info.coachCounts: A small tab on each coach panel with how many players are in Reserves and out of the game.
settings.info.colorPreset: Preset accent colors. Text color is picked automatically, so it stays readable.
settings.info.colorblind: Adjusts team and status colors for color blindness.
settings.info.controllerSupport: Turns on gamepad input. Mostly untested; the mouse and keyboard keep working.
settings.info.crosshairAccel: The crosshair speeds up to twice its speed while you hold one direction.
settings.info.crosshairSpeed: Squares per second the left stick moves the pitch crosshair. Precision (L3) halves it.
settings.info.cueActionCancel: A sound when you cancel an action.
settings.info.cueRollFailed: A sound when a dice roll fails.
settings.info.cueTurnClockCountdown: Ticks in the last 5 seconds of your turn clock.
settings.info.customizeUi: Closes Settings and shows a grip on each panel, so you can move and resize it. Press Confirm Layout when you are done.
settings.info.d6Style: The look of the six-sided dice.
settings.info.deadzoneLeft: How far the left stick must move before it counts. Raise it if a resting stick drifts; lower it for finer control.
settings.info.deadzoneRight: How far the right stick must move before it counts. Raise it if a resting stick drifts; lower it for finer control.
settings.info.debugLog: Records every event, not just dice rolls. Helps with bug reports.
settings.info.declareBlitz: FUMBBL: pick Blitz from the player menu, then the target. Modern: select your player, then click an opponent to plan the blitz.
settings.info.deferSwitch: The first click on another player sends nothing; a second click ends the previous player and switches. Clicking elsewhere, right click or Esc cancels.
settings.info.devPanel: Opens the developer log panel. The stream is always recorded for bug reports.
settings.info.dice3d: Block and action dice roll in 3D.
settings.info.diceTumble: How long the dice tumble before they settle.
settings.info.dieTagPosition: Where the roll result tag sits on a die.
settings.info.discordPresence: Shows the game you are in as your Discord activity.
settings.info.discordSpectate: Adds a Spectate button to your Discord status, so friends can watch. Needs Rich Presence.
settings.info.dugoutCounts: Adds the number of players to the Reserves and KO labels.
settings.info.endZoneLabel: The text painted in each end zone.
settings.info.endZoneTint: Tints the end zones red and blue by side.
settings.info.fieldLogos: Team logos painted on the pitch.
settings.info.flatRender: A straight top-down pitch instead of the angled view.
settings.info.flyBrainUrl: Address of the Fly brain test bot.
settings.info.fpsLimit: Caps the frame rate. Match display uses your monitor's refresh rate.
settings.info.friendlySwitch: Clicking another of your players switches to them. An untouched declaration is refunded; once anything was used, the click ends the current player.
settings.info.fullscreen: Uses the window's native fullscreen mode. F11 also toggles it.
settings.info.fumbblCreds: Your FUMBBL name and password, stored on this computer only.
settings.info.gameSound: Overall volume of the game sounds.
settings.info.gridLines: Draws the square grid on the pitch. Turn it off or recolor it if a busy turf is hard to read.
settings.info.gridOpacity: How see-through the grid lines are.
settings.info.hatred: Shows the Hatred icon only when a hated target is within reach.
settings.info.hideConfirmBar: Hides the bar under the pitch that confirms a move, block, blitz or foul. The confirm key and a second click still work.
settings.info.hideZeroRerolls: Hides a team's reroll chip once it has none left.
settings.info.hudStyle: Minimalist keeps the HUD compact and flat. Chrome adds the molded console casing.
settings.info.inputMethod: Auto switches to the pad when you press a button, and back when you use the mouse or keyboard. Xbox, DualShock and DualSense pads work.
settings.info.inputSwitchNotice: A short notice when the client switches between mouse and pad.

settings.info.jnlpLabel: Open .jnlp game links in Super FUMBBL
settings.info.language: The language for menus, prompts and game terms. Reports from the server stay in English.
settings.info.launchScreens: Which intro screens open when the client starts.
settings.info.leftClickMenu: A left click on your player opens its action menu instead of declaring Move at once. Right click always opens the menu.
settings.info.logDice: Shows rolls, and the rolls needed, as dice faces or as numbers.

settings.info.logTint: How strongly the team colors paint the Graphical rows.
settings.info.markColor: Color of Shift-click marks and telestrator drawings.
settings.info.minTextSize: No small interface text gets smaller than this. Main text always stays at 16 px or more.
settings.info.minTextSizeSample: The smallest text looks like this.
settings.info.mouseCamera: Always on: drag with the middle mouse button to pan, use the wheel to zoom.
settings.info.moveBadge: Shows the movement left at the acting player's feet.
settings.info.moveSpeed: Time per square when a player moves.
settings.info.opacity: How see-through this panel is. Lower it to see more of the pitch behind.
settings.info.pitchFlipped: Turns the pitch around, so each end zone is on the other side.
settings.info.pitchOrientation: Whether the end zones sit at the top and bottom of the screen, or at the sides.
settings.info.plannerPrimary: Color of the planned route line.
settings.info.plannerSecondary: Color of the steps on a planned route that need a roll: a dodge, a rush or a pickup.
settings.info.plannerTags: How rush, dodge and pickup rolls are marked on a planned route.
settings.info.playerPortraits: On: clicking a player opens their card. Off: the card opens only from a roster row or the Player card key.
settings.info.positionRings: A colored ring under each player, by position.
settings.info.preClickBlockDice: After you declare a Block or Blitz, the dice show over every player you can block. Off: only once you click a target.
settings.info.primaryAccent: Accent color for a Custom theme.
settings.info.renderPosition: Where the chosen list is drawn on a player: over the head, at the feet or on the token.
settings.info.renderScale: Lower it for speed, raise it for sharpness.
settings.info.resetBindings: Puts every key and controller binding back to its default.
settings.info.resetSkillConfig: Puts every skill back to its default icon or marker.
settings.info.resetUi: Puts every panel back where it started. Asks first, applies at once and is not undone by Cancel.
settings.info.ringColor: Ring color: one per position, or one color for all.
settings.info.ringDensity: How solid the position rings are.
settings.info.rosterTab: Adds a Roster tab next to Log and Chat. The roster also opens from the helmet button on the Quick bar.
settings.info.rowMarkers: Numbers along the edge of the pitch.
settings.info.rumble: The pad vibrates on dice, turnovers and casualties.
settings.info.secondaryBase: Base color for a Custom theme.
settings.info.selectionEcho: A pulse on the player you are moving.
settings.info.serverSequencing: Adds technical server steps, such as server-resolved movement, to the log.
settings.info.serverStatus: Which accounts are signed in and verified.
settings.info.serverTarget: Which game server you play on.
settings.info.serverUrl: The game server address this client connects to.
settings.info.setupFormations: Your saved formations, ready to load at setup.
settings.info.setupRulesCard: Shows the setup rules while you place players.
settings.info.setupZones: Highlights the wide zones and the line of scrimmage at setup.
settings.info.skillConfigGroup: Which list to edit below: skill icons or skill markers.
settings.info.skillDisplay: Shows skills on players as icons, or as short text markings.
settings.info.spectatorView: Which team sits where when you watch a game or a replay.
settings.info.spriteSet: Which figures are used for players. Installed mod packs add choices.
settings.info.stadium: The stands around the pitch, or none.
settings.info.sweetSpot: Marks the usual kick-off target squares.
settings.info.tackleZones: Whose tackle zones are drawn on the pitch.
settings.info.timestamps: Adds the time at the start of each log line.
settings.info.trailColor: Color of the trail left behind a moving player.
settings.info.trailMarks: What the trail shows: footprints, or numbers counting the squares moved.
settings.info.turf: The pitch surface. Installed mod packs add choices.
settings.info.turnClockLink: The warning time is set in Audio, with the other sounds.
settings.info.turnClockWarning: When the turn clock warns you that time is running out. With Visual sound cues it also shows on screen.
settings.info.turnTrack: The turn, score and reroll tracks drawn beside the pitch.
settings.info.uiColorScheme: Dark or light colors for the interface.
settings.info.uiFontSample: The quick blitzer dodges past the troll.
settings.info.uiStyle: Modern: the League Manager look. Retro: the classic Super FUMBBL look. Controls work the same in both.

settings.info.waypointSound: The sound when you add a waypoint to a planned route.
settings.info.wireLog: Writes every network message to a file, one file per game.

settings.controlLayer.label: Controls
settings.controlLayer.info: Super FUMBBL Controls is the client's own planner: plot a route, then confirm it. FUMBBL Controls works like the FUMBBL client: a left click on your player opens the action menu, a click next to the player steps there, and a target acts on one click. Only the input changes; the pitch looks the same in both.
settings.controlLayer.automoveInfo: On: a click on a distant square walks there at once, on a path that never passes through a tackle zone and never Rushes. Every Dodge and Rush is its own click. Off: one square per click.
settings.controlLayer.switchNotice: Your controls will switch to {layer} when {player}'s activation ends.
settings.rightClick.label: Right click ({layer})
settings.rightClick.info: What a right click on the pitch does. Each control layer keeps its own choice. A right click on an open confirmation still answers it with Go back.
settings.fumbblKeys.info: The FUMBBL client's keys, in either control layer: Q W E A D Y X C step one square, S selects the player under the pointer, < and Shift+< cycle your players, and Ctrl+M, B, Z, F, P, J and E pick Move, Block, Blitz, Foul, Pass, Jump and End. Turning this on disables WASD camera pan; the arrow keys, mouse drag and edge panning still pan.
settings.fumbblKeys.clash: {key} is also bound to {action}; the FUMBBL shortcut takes it.
settings.fumbblKeys.resetInfo: Puts every FUMBBL shortcut back on the FUMBBL client's key.
settings.fumbblKeys.selectHoveredPlayer: Select the player under the pointer

setupWizard.controls.lede: Choose how you play on the pitch. You can change it any time in Settings > Controls.
